_readme: Site-level settings. Edit titles, navigation and text freely. Each page is either the interactive simulator or a Markdown file from content/. Add a page by adding an entry here and creating its .md file. See documentation/EDITING_GUIDE.md. A markdown page may have an 'aside' list of source files shown in a right-hand column (stacked below the text on narrow screens).
title: Unified Compact Model for Memristor
subtitle: Interactive deterministic simulation of resistive switching
footer: Simulations run in your browser with the original Python model (via Pyodide). No data leaves your computer.

plot.labels_source: Axis labels as used in the author's stochastic.py (ax1.set_xlabel / set_ylabel); the deterministic script sets no axis labels.
